name: Ranger Pilfering: Dirty Blades swings heal for 50% of Dirty Blades' damage (#2516)
contract: Pilfering 705087 (Brigand row 7 col 9) reads 'Adds 10% to the damage dealt by Dirty Blades and causes its damage dealt to heal you equal to 50% of the value.' Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 +10 on Dirty Blades (class mask 0x1000000), effect 1 is Ascension aura 354 with BasePoints 49 + 1 = 50 and TriggerSpell 520880 'Dirty Blades' (SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL on the caster, SPELL_ATTR2_CANT_CRIT, SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS). Dirty Blades 680276 effect 0 is aura 354 with BasePoints 69 + 1 = 70, its share of each melee auto attack. aura_ascension_ranger_pilfering (spell_proc ProcFlags 4, melee auto attack) never attached before this fix because its Load() read AuraScript::GetTarget(), which is null while the script loads. Expected: with Pilfering learned and no Dirty Blades, swings heal nothing; with Dirty Blades up its effect 0 is 80 (70 + Pilfering's 10) and every swing heals for swing damage x 80% x 50% = 40% of the swing (the golem is stunned, so every swing is a plain hit). Each heal is rounded down to a whole point, so with unarmed swings of 20-30 damage the ratio sits between 0.33 and 0.40; the pre-fix reading of 50% of the whole swing gives 0.5 and a script that never attaches gives no heal at all.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fixture stun, so the golem neither fights back nor avoids swings
SETUP: Pilfering is active on the Ranger
SETUP: a swing lands without Dirty Blades
Without Dirty Blades Pilfering heals nothing
A Dirty Blades swing heals the Ranger
The heal is 50% of Dirty Blades' 80% share of the swing (integer heal per swing)
